newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine 3-,6-,12-mo T-bills yield the same.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine 3-,6-,12-mo T-bills yield the same.

text.p: The average yield at the latest auction of three-month discount treasury bills stood at 57.30 percent, the same as at the last sale on October 1, a Ukrainian central bank official said on Thursday.
The results of Wednesday's auction, compared to the last issue of three-month T-bills, were as follows:
Amount sold 107.81 million UAH 38.211 million UAH
Actual amount raised 94.338 million UAH 33.435 million UAH
Ukraine's central bank sold 1.078,144 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of discount three-month T-bills is scheduled for October 3.
The average yield at the latest auction of six-month discount treasury bills stood at 59.90 percent, the same as at the last sale on October 1, a central bank statement said.
The results of Wednesday's auction, compared to the last issue of six-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
Actual amount raised 97,090 UAH 7.089 million UAH
The central bank sold 1,261 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The next auction of six-month discount T-bills is scheduled for October 3.
The average yield at the latest auction of 12-month discount treasury bills stood at 62.77 percent the same as at the last sale on October 1, a central bank statement said.
The results of Wednesday's auction, compared to the last issue of 12-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
The central bank sold 99 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of 12-month discount T-bills is scheduled for October 3.
